text: Ironhide Devilsaurs patrol Un'Goro Crater and are sometimes called "Ninjasaurs" by players, due to the fact that the have a reputation for coming up behind a questing player. The main reason of killing this creature is to receive the Devilsaur Leather, which is used in some crafting recipes.
__NOTOC__ Ironblade Gauntlets drop from The Maker in the Blood Furnace on Normal mode.

Irondeep Mine is a mine found in the northern area of Alterac Valley, north of Stonehearth Graveyard. In theory, due to its proximity to Dun Baldar, it should be captured by the Alliance more often than the Horde. However, in many battles the mine is ignored at the start; and only captured once the Horde have taken it or when the Alliance is pushed onto the defensive. At the beginning of the battle, the mine is owned by Irondeep troggs led by Morloch. Irondeep Mine, like its counterpart Coldtooth Mine, produces supplies for ground assaults (to be transported by a player) and 1 reinforcement to the fraction owning the mine.

Ironclad Cove is the large walled-in cove that now acts a monumental cavern in which lies the Defias juggernaught. On one side of the cavern is the massive door made for the juggernaught to pass through once it is finished, and its other side can be seen in northern Stranglethorn Vale. In the middle is the shipyard and docks surrounding the ship. Admiral Ripsnarl, "Captain" Cookie and Vanessa VanCleef can all be found here. On the opposite side from where you enter is the instance exit. It was previously held by a pirate crew, which was murdered by the Defias when they took over the area. At some point, the area was invaded by Jerias Bloodvein of the Bloodsail Buccaneers and his pirate crew.

Ironband's Blastpowder is a quest chain available to the Alliance. It seems that Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan has been having problems getting supplies to continue his excavations, and he is in need of a courier to find out what happened. This also introduces the Dark Iron dwarves.

The Ironforge Brigade is an Alliance military force, mostly composed of Ironforge dwarves, that saw action during the campaign in Silithus. Based from their outpost near Hive'Zora, they guarded against the nearby hive and supported the Cenarion Hold in fighting the silithid and aqir hordes pouring across the region. During the offensive, they remained short on supplies and rewarded members of the Alliance with Cenarion Logistics Badges, which could be traded for rewards at Cenarion Hold. After the successful campaign, the Ironforge Brigade apparently remained stationed in Silithus. As of the end of the Burning Legion's third invasion of Azeroth and the Argus Campaign, several bodies of the I

An Ironforge Gift Collection is a collection of the three Ironforge pledge item packages, and is the second hierarchical combining of the pledge items given out by various Ironforge NPCs during the Love is in the Air seasonal event.

An Ironforge Guard's Card is a pledge gift given out by Ironforge Guard NPCs during the Love is in the Air seasonal event. These are combined into packages which are in turn hierarchically combined with other pledge packages for buffs and rewards. All of the Love is in the Air pledge gifts are non-functional as regards their name and picture. You cannot read an Ironforge Guard's Card. __NOTOC__

All of the Love is in the Air pledge gift packages are non-functional as regards their name and picture. You cannot read an Ironforge Pledge Collection. __NOTOC__
Ironforge Gift of Friendship is a 60 minute +30 stamina buff gained after creating an from the three Ironforge pledge item packages during the Love is in the Air event.

Iron giants are a type of giant in Northrend. In ancient times, they were led by the keepers to make war on the Old Gods and free Azeroth from their will. In the Iron army, they were allied with the iron dwarves and iron vrykul in the service of Loken, their creator. As such, they were at war with the frost giants, earthen, and frostborn. Stone giants, such as Archavon the Stone Watcher, are another form of giant and were often found enthralled by Loken. Despite the defeat of both Loken and Yogg-Saron, there are still many iron troops throughout Northrend. Thorim and Mimiron are looking for a way to "fix" them.

Iron vrykul are the original form of the vrykul, before they were afflicted with the Curse of Flesh. They were created by the titan Keepers from the Forge of Wills, in the Halls of Lightning wing of Ulduar, alongside many other titan-forged such as the earthen. Keeper Loken, corrupted by the Old God Yogg-Saron who took control of the titan facility of Ulduar, churned out entire armies of iron vrykul through the Forge of Wills. Following Loken's death and Yogg-Saron's defeat, they have then re-entered the service of the Keepers as evidenced in Ulduar during the Burning Legion's third invasion.
Iron golems are runic golems made of iron that are built by the iron dwarves. They can be found throughout Northrend, such as in the Howling Fjord and Ulduar.
Ironforge Cavalrymen were part of the forces during the Ahn'Qiraj War Effort world event in Silithus.

The Irondeeps are a group of gray-skinned troggs found residing within Irondeep Mine in the Alterac Valley. Before the fighting in Alterac started, the Stormpike Guard stored supplies for Dun Baldar in the Irondeep Mine. The troggs that surfaced there weren't much of a problem for the dwarves when they had spare troops to guard the mine.

Ironman is a player vs. player achievement earned for capturing 3 flags without dying in a single match in the Warsong Gulch battleground. Required for the meta-achievement Master of Warsong Gulch.

The Ironforge Siege Brigade (a.k.a. Ironforge Steam Brigade or Steam Tank Brigade and simply the Siege Brigade) is the brigade of Ironforge's siege engine pilots. They're based in Ironforge and Steelgrill's Depot. Always looking for ways to improve their tanks, they often hire adventurers to gather supplies for them. The brigade seems to have had up to 19 siege engines, equipped with black boxes, one of which was lost in the Badlands.

The iron army (also known as the iron armies and iron legions) of Keeper Loken was made of the combined forces of the iron dwarves, iron vrykul, iron golems, and iron giants, respectively led by three fearsome generals known as Stormcaller Brundir, Runemaster Molgeim, and Steelbreaker. These commanders constituted the Assembly of Iron. The fire giants were responsible for the production of more iron soldiers. Fjorn was capable of creating giants of iron known as Stormforged Iron Giants, Volkhan overseen the Iron Crucible where he was seen assembling iron vrykul, and Ignis the Furnace Master once toiled over the Colossal Forge, creating the iron armies that would conquer Azeroth in Yogg-Saron

The Ironman Challenge is a popular challenge of gameplay where one must make a character in very unusual circumstances. It has become quite popular and is subject to much discussion on the public forums. It consists of armor, weapon, addon, specialization, potion and food regulations. Most importantly, death is prohibited, lest you restart at level one.

The Ironbound are an army of troggs belonging to the leper gnome Telzo Sparkspanner, encountered during the Heritage of Gnomeregan questline. Telzo intended to use them to decimate all of gnomanity. After traveling to the Storm Peaks to confront Sparkspanner, G.E.A.R. encountered more troggs at the Foot Steppes and the Terrace of the Makers. The Iron Trench is located in southern Maldraxxus, between the Theater of Pain, the House of the Chosen, and the Seat of the Primus. It is bordered to the east by the Valley of a Thousand Legs. This ancient battlefield is strewn with the remains of countless failed attacks upon the Seat of the Primus by forces which threatened the Shadowlands as well as an attempted coup attempt against the Primus himself. It also contains a number of Faded Epitaphs dedicated to fallen Necrolord heroes. The necromantic energies unleashed by the countless battles waged here has coalesced into a number of deathwalkers.

Isalien is a priest spirit summoned in Dire Maul East as part of the Dungeon 2 quest line after killing Alzzin the Wildshaper. Of the four random summonable bosses for the Dungeon 2 upgrade questline, she is arguably the easiest to take down. Isalien was once a member of the mercenary-company Veiled Blade. After she and her fellow mercenaries failed at assassinating Lord Valthalak in Blackrock Spire, she abandoned the company and traveled in pilgrimage to Dire Maul. There, she sought both to learn more about her elven heritage and to find a usage for her piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, which she had received as share of the loot after the failed assassination. She escaped the fate of her friends and allies by being their ill-fated ambassador to the blood elves at Firewing Point at the time of the attack. Isfar is an arakkoa quest giver located inside the Sethekk Halls in Auchindoun. Isfar is an exile from the Sethekk, the clan who took up residence in the Sethekk Halls after the Auchindoun explosion. His brother, Darkweaver Syth, was one of the leaders of the Sethekk who believed that the explosion heralded the second coming of Terokk; Isfar was later exiled for doubting Syth and his ally, Talon King Ikiss. He resides outside the Sethekk Halls, where he calls on adventurers to kill his brother and free his sister, Lakka, from her imprisonment at the hands of the Darkweaver.

Isiden Perenolde was the nephew of Lord Aiden Perenolde, King of Alterac. When Alterac was placed under martial law by order of King Terenas, Isiden fled to Gilneas, where he hoped to rally support. He was eventually backed by Genn Greymane, Gilneas' king, as the matter of the succession began to heat up. Nothing has been heard from Isiden since then and his status is unknown.

Iskaal Refugee are tuskarr refugees located in Kamagua in the Howling Fjord, mainly in and around Caregiver Iqniq's inn. Periodically, a group of three Iskaal Refugees spawn at the eastern entrance of town, stop by Akiaruk to offer a word of thanks, and then walk down into the inn and despawn.
Isuldof Iceheart is one of the ghosts whose burial mound was desecrated by the Northsea Freebooters.

Iskaal is a ruined tuskarr village located east of Kamagua in the Howling Fjord. You can get there by taking the Ancient Lift. It is currently controlled by the Northsea Freebooters. Abdul the Insane is found on the ship nearby. The surviving tuskarr made their escape to Kamagua.
Irradiated Manager is a goblin located at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.
Is That Your Goblin? is part of The Sons of Hodir quest chain.

The Ironwall Dam is a massive dam made of saronite that separates Icecrown from the Crystalsong Forest. The Decrepit Flow is set below the dam in Crystalsong, and the Broken Front lies beyond it. The dam's openings and ramparts are guarded by Pustulent Horrors. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard reported that the dam was still patrolled by the Scourge.

.]] The Ironwall Rampart overlooks the Valley of Fallen Heroes. It is located south of The Shadow Vault in Icecrown. The rampart dominates the fields below on all sides, and according to both Thassarian and Koltira Deathweaver this rampart must be taken before the army can advance to Icecrown Citadel, which is why they send the player to kill the cultist overseer there, Grimkor the Wicked and place barricades in the valley below to aid the assault. During Death Rising, the Argent Crusade secured and used this area as a forward base. The camp was occasionally under attack by Scourge forces.

.]] Issliruk is the tuskarr spirit of war. He is depicted as a silver eagle, and tuskarr stories tell of how he fought against a hundred worgs to save his young. Alongside the other tuskarr deities, Issliruk aided Kaskala when it was attacked by the kvaldir, specifically by giving the tuskarr courage. Elder Muahit used Issliruk's totem to summon the Spirit of Issliruk and create an unnatural snowstorm, which slowed down the kvaldir's ships and created enough confusion for adventurers to kill the kvaldir leader, Heigarr the Slayer.

Isle of Conquest Mark of Honor was a reward for completing a game at the Isle of Conquest. Players of the winning faction received three, and players of the losing faction just one. These, and , were not used to turn in for any PvP rewards unlike any other marks, and served no purpose.
Isle of Conquest Veteran is a player vs. player achievement earned for completing 100 victories in Isle of Conquest. This is a cumulative achievement.

Isle of Conquest Victory is a player vs. player achievement earned for participating and winning a battle of Isle of Conquest. This achievement is indirectly part of the Master of Isle of Conquest meta-achievement, as 100 such victories are required for , which is required for the meta achievement.

Ironwood Staves and Wands is a weapon shop found in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. They, as indicated by their name, sell staves and wands. Its name is probably a reference to the Ironwood trees.
Isabel Jones sells jewelcrafting recipes at the cost of Illustrious Jewelcrafter's Token, which are awarded after you complete her daily quests.
It's Frost Damage is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for allowing three Freezing Vapors to cast Coalesce during the Admiral Ripsnarl encounter in Deadmines on Heroic difficulty.
